## Change

Describe the problem and the affected module, tooling or catalog records.

## Verification

Commands, results, skipped checks and runtime versions. Include browser evidence
for storefront changes and affected-record counts for data changes.

## Checklist

- [ ] Changes are focused; identifiers and provenance are preserved where applicable.
- [ ] Regression tests or a reproducible verification procedure are included.
- [ ] No credentials, private data, catalog images or release archives were added to Git.
- [ ] Applicable licenses and third-party notices are preserved.
- [ ] Documentation distinguishes tested behavior from unverified compatibility.
- [ ] Release or migration impact is described; existing published assets remain immutable.
